text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through the shopping street
with
Winning Ticket on our day off.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is someone wagging their tail over
there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On closer inspection, there's a girl
walking to and
fro, her tail flicking side
to side.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooh! It's her—it's Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HEEEY! YUKIIII!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wowie! It's Tickezo! I thought an
avalanche
was comin' or something!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sorry about that! So what are you
doing
out here? Shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urghh... Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's our day off, so I picked up all the
courage I
darn well could t'go buy some
hip new duds.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Cause you know, I'm tryin' hard t'be a
proper city
girl! But then...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I feel so outta place in this uniform, an'
the
crowd's so thick, I can't take a single
'nother step
from this spot!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... I mean, not really, but it
sounds like
you're in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
How about I come with you? I wanted to
look at
clothes too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't ask a true blue city girl like
y'self to
accomp'ny me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? A-am I a city girl?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, no, if you want a real city girl, you'd
really be
better off asking City herself!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! You're a prop'r city girl to me,
Tickezo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Like those clothes you're wearin'—you
make them
look so fash'nable! I'm sure
they'd just look like
plain ol' PJs if I
tried'm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wow, y-you really think so? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No foolin'! How d'you pick your clothes
anyhow?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Umm, first off, they have to be easy to
move in.
And I get a lot of
hand-me-downs from my
brother!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Those are a little big, but they're totally
my
style! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, is that a fact?! No wond'r you look
so
natur'lly stylish!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But how 'bout me? What should I do
t'pick
clothes without lookin' like I try
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuhhh... Honestly, I don't know
anything about
fashion...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Traineeerrr! Help!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oohhh! That sounds like something a pro
would
say!

text_block_list.name: Ticket and Yukino
text_block_list.text: Oh... Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Awesome! Such fashion wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly! Your trainer's a bonafide genius!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go search for clothes that suit you,
Yuki!
We'll look SUPER hard!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch! I think I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Great! The search begiiins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of the day walking
around the
stores and judging outfits,
until we can barely
take another step.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that mean?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's kinda similar to what City was
sayin'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If you have an image of yourself, stick
to it, even
if it means putting up with
heels or cold in the
winter."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's great to find clothes that suit you.
But
sometimes it's worth fitting yourself
to the look
instead," she said!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! That's City for you, the master
of
fashion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wait, but if that was a fashion master's wisdom... And Trainer just said basically the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! That's right! You're not just a trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ticket and Yukino
text_block_list.text: You're a master of fashion yourself!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yuki, let's get all the ideas we can from
our
fashion master!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Any clothes that a master chooses
will be a
surefire hit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After being so highly rated by these two
honest
Umamusume, I end up having to
give my opinion
for the rest of the
shopping trip.
